title: Add a library-only fault hook and table-driven failing tests before and after journal creation, every pre-commit target, the ready-journal write, and immediately before the commit point. At every boundary the failed call leaves the item not done and an uninjected retry reaches one byte-consistent final state. Add an orchestration regression that an unfinished finalized attempt with a matching journal emits `needs-complete`. Verify with `node --test test/finalization-recovery.test.mjs test/orchestration.test.mjs`.
